name: agent-hq-mcp
description: Adds your Agent HQ's MCP server (hq_discover and hq_call) to Claude Code. Install it next to agent-hq unless HQ already reaches you through a claude.ai connector.

hq_url.title: HQ MCP URL
hq_url.description: Your HQ's MCP endpoint, for example https://hq.example.com/mcp

hq_api_key.title: HQ API key
hq_api_key.description: An HQ MCP API key (the AGENTHQ_API_KEY value set on your HQ)
